outing.hero_prompt_english: Chateau Changyu AFIP in Miyun: a recognizable European-inspired stone winery chateau with steep dark roof, slender corner turrets and a courtyard, orderly autumn grapevines and a small pedestrian leisure village. Adult friends share a casual lunch with tea, not wine. Focus on architecture and garden design, no brand labels, no alcohol-centered scene. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
